description: This file declares the SoC_GstPlayer class, which manages a GStreamer-based media player for Miracast streaming, including pipeline management, playback controls, and statistics.

classes.name: SoC_GstPlayer
classes.description: A singleton C++ class managing GStreamer pipeline for Miracast streaming with controls and statistics.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the class.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Initializes and starts the GStreamer pipeline with specified local IP, port, and RTSP message.

methods.name: setVideoRectangle
methods.description: Sets the video display rectangle (dimensions and position).

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Gets total duration of the media.

methods.name: seekTo
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the media.

methods.name: get_player_statistics
methods.description: Gathers and logs statistics about the current playback.

methods.name: print_pipeline_state
methods.description: Prints the current state of the GStreamer pipeline.
